# nautobot_ip_address (Resource)

This object manages an IP address in Nautobot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nautobot_namespace" "global" {
  name = "Global"
}

data "nautobot_prefix" "example" {
  prefix       = "10.151.0.0/16"
  namespace_id = data.nautobot_namespace.global.id
}

resource "nautobot_ip_address" "example" {
  address      = "10.151.0.10/16"
  status       = "Active"
  namespace_id = data.nautobot_namespace.global.id
  type         = "host"
  dns_name     = "app01.example.com"
  description  = "Primary IP for app01"
}

output "resource_ip_address" {
  value = nautobot_ip_address.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address in CIDR notation (e.g. `10.0.0.10/24`).
- `status` (String) Status (by name) of the IP address.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the IP address.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name associated with the IP address.
- `namespace_id` (String) UUID of the namespace associated with the IP address. Defaults to the `Global` namespace or the parent prefix's namespace when omitted.
- `nat_inside_id` (String) UUID of the inside IP address for which this address is the NAT outside IP.
- `parent_id` (String) UUID of the parent prefix containing this IP address. Automatically determined by Nautobot if omitted.
- `role_id` (String) Role UUID associated with the IP address.
- `tags_ids` (Set of String) Tags (UUIDs) associated with the IP address.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID associated with the IP address.
- `type` (String) Type of the IP address (`host`, `dhcp`, or `slaac`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `display` (String) Human-friendly display value.
- `host` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 host address without mask.
- `id` (String) IP address UUID.
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version of the IP address (4 or 6).
- `mask_length` (Number) Length of the network mask, in bits.
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the IP address.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the IP address.
- `url` (String) API URL of the IP address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# IP addresses can be imported using their unique ID, e.g. '748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7'
terraform import nautobot_ip_address.example "748ca2dd-a3ac-5bb6-8b4a-276b7e3c33c7"
```
